event: "Well, you might want to hurry up then, Firrelia!" Nala grunts through her teeth.
The blue words give no answer; they thin and fade out of the air.
She throws herself forward from the ground, over the beast, arms reaching for its neck.
The instant her body touches its back, the flat quills spring up all at once.
Glass drives into her forearms and the insides of her arms, a spray of small, bright cuts.
She gets her arms round it anyway, but its neck is short and thick, and quilled at the nape.
Her grip will not close; there is nothing like a neck there to squeeze, only muscle and glass.
The beast twists under her, and every twist snaps off more shards into her skin.
Its jaws stay locked on her calf the whole time, grinding.
Her hands slide down its front as it heaves, over skin that is suddenly soft and bare.
Its throat and belly have no quills at all, and its jaw sits just above her fingers.
Her arms are running with blood, her grip is slipping, and it is still hanging on.
